title: Agent Forge Package Index
description: A compact index for one Agent Forge source revision. It points to package records; it does not contain installation binaries.

sourceId.description: Must equal the source manifest sourceId.

sourceManifest.description: POSIX path to the source manifest, relative to the index location. Usually source.json.

sourceUrl.description: Optional canonical URL of the source manifest.

agentId.description: Must equal the source manifest agentId.

type.description: Must equal the source manifest type.

revision.description: Must equal the source manifest revision.

ttl.description: Recommended number of seconds before consumers refresh this index.

indexChecksum.description: Optional digest of the canonical index bytes. Producers should define and document whether this value is calculated over a normalized copy with the field omitted.

packages.description: Package records keyed by source-local package name.

path.description: POSIX path to a package record relative to the source base URL.

recordRevision.description: Optional revision of the package record.

id.description: Global package identity, distinct from the source-local name.

displayName.description: Optional display title copied from the latest package record; does not change identity or routing.

media.description: Optional icon and first preview from the selected package record; unverified image references.

summary.description: Description copied from the latest package record for search.

facets.description: Controlled labels copied from the latest record; not guarantees.

customFacets.description: User-defined labels copied from the latest record; not verified.

updatedAt.description: Latest record timestamp for catalog ordering.

searchText.description: Generated search text; does not change package type or compatibility.

subtype.description: Administrator-defined subtype copied into this projection; null means no subtype.
